title: Rerun Limit QA
eyebrow: QA · #453: stop builders rerunning the same check

short.lead: Both halves of #453 are built on branch ccr-e35d967e-dmwsj0 as house-rules 2.75.0. Every builder now carries a limit of two runs per in-game or harness check (2.74.3). The guard hook now refuses any agent's third run of the same project script when no commit since its last run changed a file other than that script (2.75.0). A real Claude Code session with a builder subagent saw both outcomes: the third run was refused, and the run after a code commit went through. That session also showed a bug, which is fixed: a run the guard refused for another reason used to count toward the limit anyway. Nothing reaches PlunderSpell until this is merged into main and the plugin updates there.
short.hint: Tap a row to see what was checked and how.
items: A builder's third run is refused

Real session, throwaway repo, plugin loaded from this branch with --plugin-dir. A house-rules:builder ran bash tools/x.sh twice; the third call was refused with: "`tools/x.sh` has run twice since the last commit that changed code. Stop: read the code for the cause and report what failed, without editing the check."
A code commit allows two more runs

In the same session the builder committed a change to src.txt, and its next run of tools/x.sh printed "check ran with d". verify.py cases 193 and 194 check that a commit changing only the script does not reset the count.
git status, compile commands, and runs the guard refused
verify.py cases 192 and 197 check this. Case 197 was added after the real session lost a builder's first run to an unrelated refusal; with the fix removed, case 197 fails.
verify.py: all 973 checks pass. tools/verify_tools.py: all 47 pass. docref.py check: OK.

After the merge, update the plugin on your PC and start a new PlunderSpell session. Ask a builder for a co-op check: its third run of the same script without a commit should be refused with the stop-and-report message.
Run it, then pass or fail QA.

changes: Builders may run a check twice, must never edit a check to make it pass, and must read the code between runs.
Builders had a limit on test suites only.
Builders carry the two-run limit; parent agents don't use a measured number as the only condition for calling a task done, and check a running builder after 10 minutes.
The guard counts runs per session, per agent, per project script.
Any agent could run the same script without limit.
The third run is refused; a commit that changes a file other than the script resets it; HOUSE_RULES_RERUNS=off turns it off.
Every project script counts, helpers such as eval.sh and verify.py included, as you chose with option 1B.

unverified: Not yet run on your PC or in PlunderSpell; the real sessions ran in this cloud sandbox
With option 1B (every project script counts), helper scripts such as eval.sh count too; how often that interrupts ordinary work is unmeasured
